blocks.text: INDIANAPOLIS — Caitlin Clark still wants Kelsey Mitchell as a teammate — even though Clark understands that’s not always easy. In her final interview of the WNBA season, Clark denounced the hateful messages Mitchell says she’s received on social media and urged the soon-to-be free agent to stay with the Indiana Fever for one more season. Mitchell has spent her entire nine-year career with Indiana. Clark also said she was “upset” Mitchell or anyone else would be subjected to degrading remarks.
